option_relations.rationale: Thymic carcinoma is a type of thymic cancer, but the option specifies paraneoplastic syndrome (Myasthenia Gravis) which is not directly related to cardiac compression.
Type A thymoma is a type of thymic tumor, but MINOCA is a cardiac condition not directly related to cardiac compression by a thymic mass.
Coronary microvascular dysfunction is a cardiac condition, not directly related to cardiac compression by a thymic mass.
Acute coronary syndrome (Type 2 myocardial infarction) is a cardiac condition, not directly related to cardiac compression by a thymic mass.
